import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.PID
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Localization
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Integer
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.GaussLemma
/-! Isolated existing Gauss APIs and full target closure audit. -/
#check_failure Roth.exists_int_factors
#check @Polynomial.IsPrimitive.mul_map_mem_lifts_iff
#check @Polynomial.IsPrimitive.map_mul_mem_lifts_iff
#check @Polynomial.IsPrimitive.dvd_of_fraction_map_dvd_fraction_map
#check @IsLocalization.exists_integer_multiple
#check @MvPolynomial.degrees_map_of_injective
#check @Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul
namespace Factors176Mathlib
variable {R K : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsGCDMonoid R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
theorem actual_gauss {f : Polynomial R} (hf : f.IsPrimitive) {g : Polynomial K}
    (h : f.map (algebraMap R K) * g ∈ Polynomial.lifts (algebraMap R K)) :
    g ∈ Polynomial.lifts (algebraMap R K) := hf.map_mul_mem_lifts_iff.mp h
#print axioms actual_gauss
end Factors176Mathlib
namespace Factors176Closure
open MvPolynomial
variable {τ : Type*}
example {U' : MvPolynomial τ ℚ} {V' : Polynomial ℚ} (_hU : U' ≠ 0) (_hV : V' ≠ 0)
    {F : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℤ} (hF : map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) F =
      rename some U' * Polynomial.aeval (X none : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℚ) V') : True := by
  fail_if_success
    have h : ∃ (U : MvPolynomial τ ℤ) (V : Polynomial ℤ), U ≠ 0 ∧ V ≠ 0 ∧
        F = rename some U * Polynomial.aeval (X none : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℤ) V ∧
        (∀ j, degreeOf j U = degreeOf j U') ∧ V.natDegree = V'.natDegree := by
      simpa only using hF
    exact True.intro
  exact True.intro
end Factors176Closure
